sample_unit: patients flagged by the machine learning model

links.outcome: Share of model-flagged patients removed after expert chart review against the clinical record
links.effect: 208 of 388 flagged patients (54%) were removed from outreach after expert review; 115 of the 208 (55%) had a low likelihood of FH.
links.quote: After expert review, 208 (54%) patients were removed from outreach for meeting exclusion criteria.

links.outcome: Clinical visits and new diagnoses yielded by direct-to-patient outreach to model-flagged high-risk patients
links.effect: Outreach yielded 72 clinical visits (19%) and 58 new diagnoses of possible/probable/definite FH (15%), versus about 0.4% expected in general-population screening. The process was labor intensive.
links.quote: A high-touch, direct-to-patient outreach process yielded 72 clinical visits (19%) and 58 new diagnoses of possible/probable/definite FH (15%).

screen.reason: Evaluated a live clinical implementation of an ML screening tool combined with clinician chart review and direct-to-patient outreach to identify familial hypercholesterolemia.

primary.practice: expert clinician chart review prior to patient outreach
